contents_tesim: Arabic is visible on fols. 1r-v, 2v (barely), 3r (two words can be recognized: “anger” – spelled colloquially, which may point to a Christian text – and “God”), and 3v. Fol. 1r has “upon the parents” and “by his/its rays”. This is probably a theological or ethical Christian text, perhaps Patristic
